question: Acid-fast bacilli smear microscopy of endometrial curettings or menstrual blood is the most reliable and sensitive diagnostic test for female genital tuberculosis.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. Smear microscopy is unreliable for genital TB due to the paucibacillary nature of the disease. Histopathology of endometrial curettings (caseating granulomas) and Lowenstein-Jensen culture or PCR/CBNAAT are the preferred diagnostic tools.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Incorrect. This statement is false. Smear microscopy (ZN stain) has very low sensitivity for genital TB because the disease is paucibacillary — organism numbers are far too low for smear detection. The preferred diagnostic methods are endometrial curettings sent for histopathology (caseating granulomas) and Lowenstein-Jensen culture or PCR (Gen-Xpert MTB/RIF). Culture remains the gold standard despite its 6–8 week turnaround.
